Name: The Motherlode (extra coal in levels 31-39)
Author: JaneElliot
Description:
[size=4][b]The dark mine levels are full of monsters and have limited resources. Ever wonder why the original miners kept going until they found the crystal caves?[/b][/size]

The answer: amazingly rich coal nodes. 

[b]Highlights[/b]:[list]
[*]Adds extremely high-yield coal nodes (20-50 coal per node)
[*]Coal nodes are almost black and invisible in the dark, so be sure to bring a light!
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]:
[list]
[*]Should work with everything. That said, spawn rates will drop significantly if playing with other mods that add nodes to the mines (though you should get at least one high-yield coal node per level.)
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]:
[list]
[*]Requires Content Patcher and Item Extensions
[*]Unzip the file and copy to your Mods folder
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] I primarily made this mod for my own gameplay, so I'm not going to worry about balance (feel free to tweak the content.json if you think there is too much/too little coal dropping). [b]Enjoy![/b]
